title: Algal nuclei isolation for Nanopore sequencing of HMW DNA
author: Robert Auber
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7b7hirn
materials: Chill 50 ml conical tubes (4 per sample) and NIB buffers on ice.

steps.title: Prepare NIB with BME
steps.instruction: Add 35 µL β‑mercaptoethanol (BME) to 35 mL premade NIB per sample.

steps.title: Make 10 % Triton X‑100 NIB
steps.instruction: Aliquot 1.8 mL of the BME‑supplemented NIB and add 200 µL Triton X‑100 to obtain a 10 % Triton X‑100 NIB solution per sample.

steps.title: Pellet cells by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Transfer 20 mL of algal culture into a pre‑chilled 50 mL conical tube and centrifuge at 4 °C for 10 min (00:10:00) to pellet cells; ensure pellet size is at least lentil‑size for 5 µm alga and adjust speed as needed for the organism.

steps.title: Snap‑freeze cell pellet
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant, then snap‑freeze the tube in liquid nitrogen for at least 3 min (00:03:00).

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in ice‑cold NIB
steps.instruction: Place the pellet on ice and add 10 mL ice‑cold NIB; if the pellet is not readily soluble, add 1 mL NIB first, pipette up/down with a 1 mL pipette, then add the remaining 9 mL. Perform any required tissue disruption before this step.

steps.title: Homogenize nuclei suspension
steps.instruction: Mix gently by slowly pipetting up and down with a 10 mL serological pipettor until the suspension is smooth and free of clumps.

steps.title: Filter through 100 µm mesh
steps.instruction: Place a 100 µm filter on a pre‑chilled 50 mL conical tube, slowly pour the suspension through, then wash the filter with 10 mL ice‑cold NIB using a serological pipettor.

steps.title: Filter through 70 µm mesh
steps.instruction: Place a 70 µm filter on a second pre‑chilled 50 mL conical tube, slowly pour the filtrate through, and wash the filter with 10 mL ice‑cold NIB using a serological pipettor.

steps.title: Filter through 40 µm mesh
steps.instruction: Place a 40 µm filter on a third pre‑chilled 50 mL conical tube, slowly pour the filtrate through, and add 1.5 mL ice‑cold NIB containing Triton X to the filtrate.

steps.title: Pellet nuclei
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the filtered suspension at 4 °C for 10 min (00:10:00) to pellet nuclei; adjust centrifugation speed as needed for the organism’s genome size.

steps.title: Stain nuclei with propidium iodide
steps.instruction: Aliquot 1 µL of the nuclear pellet into a clean 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube, add 18 µL fresh NIB and 1 µL propidium iodide, and mix gently.

steps.title: Verify nuclei fluorescence
steps.instruction: Transfer the stained nuclei to a microscope slide and observe under epifluorescent illumination; confirm fluorescing nuclei using a Nikon Ts2R‑FL microscope with CFP LP cube (Excitation 448 ± 11.5 nm, Emission 472 nm long‑pass).

steps.title: Extract high‑molecular‑weight DNA
steps.instruction: Follow the Circulomics Plant Nuclei Big DNA Kit (Alpha version) protocol to isolate HMW DNA from the nuclei (see https://www.circulomics.com/store/Nanobind-Plant-Nuclei-Big-DNA-Kit-Alpha-Version-p99924200).

steps.title: Post‑extraction filtration
steps.instruction: Slowly pour the DNA‑containing sample through the appropriate filter into a clean tube without washing with NIB.

steps.title: Set thermomixer temperature
steps.instruction: Set the thermomixer to 55 °C for downstream incubations.
